Package de.gematik.bbriccs.jwt

Class JweTokenParser

java.lang.Object
de.gematik.bbriccs.jwt.JweTokenParser
public class JweTokenParser extends Object
Extracts access and nested JWT values from token responses and handles compact JWE payloads encrypted with AES-GCM.

The extraction methods locate the corresponding quoted property in the supplied text. The JWE methods use a five-part compact representation containing a protected header, an encrypted-key segment, an initialization vector, ciphertext, and an authentication tag.

    • decrypt

      public String decrypt(String compactJwe, byte[] tokenKey)
      Decrypts the payload of a five-part compact JWE using AES-GCM.

      The protected-header segment is used as authenticated additional data. The supplied key must be a valid AES key, and the JWE authentication tag must verify successfully.

      Parameters:
      compactJwe - five-part compact JWE string
      tokenKey - AES key bytes used to decrypt the payload
      Returns:
      decrypted payload decoded as UTF-8
      Throws:
      JweTokenParserException - if compactJwe is null or does not have exactly five parts
      GeneralSecurityException - if AES-GCM decryption fails, including when the key is invalid or the authentication tag does not verify

    • encrypt

      public String encrypt(String payload, byte[] tokenKey)
      Encrypts a UTF-8 payload into a five-part compact JWE using direct AES-GCM encryption.

      The protected header declares alg=dir and enc=A256GCM; the key must therefore be 256 bits. The encrypted-key segment is empty. This method uses a zero-filled IV; AES-GCM requires a unique IV for every encryption under a given key, so do not reuse a key across calls.

      Parameters:
      payload - plaintext to encrypt
      tokenKey - 256-bit AES key bytes
      Returns:
      five-part compact JWE string
      Throws:
      GeneralSecurityException - if encryption fails or the key is not valid for AES-GCM
